Verses.1: Now I say, as long as an heir is a minor, they are no different from a slave. Even though the heir is the master of all.
Verses.2: The heir is subject to guardians and managers until the date set by the father.
Verses.3: We also, when we were children, were enslaved under the elementary principles of the world.
Verses.4: Then, when the fullness of time came, God sent His Son. He was born by a woman, born under the law
Verses.5: to redeem those who were under the law. All that so we might receive adoption as children.
Verses.6: Because you are children, God sent the Spirit of His Son into our hearts, crying out, "Abba! Father!"
Verses.7: Therefore, you are no longer a slave but God's child. If you are a child, you are also an heir by the grace of God.

Changes: 2025-02-03 - Paul Prins: First translation of verses 1-7 based on Greek.
